scenes.title: The Problem
scenes.text: In distributed systems, independent servers must agree on a single shared state, even when nodes fail.

scenes.title: Leader Election
scenes.text: Raft solves this by electing a leader. If a node times out, it requests votes until it wins a majority quorum.

scenes.title: Log Replication
scenes.text: The leader accepts client commands and broadcasts them across the cluster through heartbeat messages.

scenes.title: Quorum Commitment
scenes.text: Once a majority of followers acknowledge the entry, it commits permanently. The cluster reaches consensus.
